topics.name: Voltage divider
topics.question: How does a divider set an output voltage?
topics.assetAlt: Fixture diagram of a two-resistor voltage divider
topics.summary: Two resistors in series divide a source voltage in proportion to resistance.

sections.heading: Core idea
paragraphs: The output is taken across `R2`, so **Vout = Vin · R2 / (R1 + R2)**.

topics.hint: Trace one example through the lab circuit before re-reading theory.
